subject: Re: Cleartower order form — invoice routing, phased minimum commit
messages:
From: Simon Lawrence <simon.lawrence@cleartower.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cleartower.com, elsa@cleartower.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Cleartower order form — a couple final asks on invoicing and min commits

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the walk-through last week. Legal passed back a few narrowly scoped asks on the order form before they can sign the MSA + OF:

1) Invoice delivery: they want invoices sent to procurement@cleartower.com and AP to be able to accept either a single consolidated USD invoice per month, or separate entity-level invoices if we need to respect local VAT/residency. Which route do you propose if Redwood needs to route by entity?

2) Minimum commit phasing: Cleartower prefers a phased min-commit (Q1 50%, Q2 30%, Q3 20%) with the ability to re‑allocate unused commit within the contract year. Is that something we can support in the OF or does it require a manual amendment process?

3) VAT/reserve: their tax team is asking for language about VAT withholding/reserve handling — who will hold evidence if they withhold?

I attached the last redline they ran with our earlier comments. Can you confirm which items we can accept vs. which need legal redlines? We have a target sign date of 1 Aug.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Simon
Simon Lawrence
VP Procurement, Cleartower Corp
——
Attachment: Cleartower_OrderForm_Redline_v3.docx
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: simon.lawrence@cleartower.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, elsa@cleartower.com, procurement@cleartower.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleartower order form — invoice routing, phased minimum commit

Hi Simon — thanks for sending this and for the target date. Looping in Kimberly (finance), Karthik (legal ops), and Ben (account exec) so we can triage quickly. Summary below and next steps.

Quick answers (high-level):
- Invoice routing: we can support either consolidated monthly invoice or entity-level invoices. Entity-level invoices require us to map which contract line items are billed to which Redwood legal entity and may add an extra week for AP onboarding.
- Phased min-commit: we can model the Q1/Q2/Q3 split in the OF as milestone tranches with invoice triggers. Re-allocation of unused commit within the contract year is operationally doable but we need explicit language in the OF to avoid accounting mismatches.
- VAT/withholding evidence: Redwood requires the purchasing entity to provide withholding receipts and tax evidence; if Cleartower withholds, we need an AP contact and a process to exchange evidence so Finance can apply credits.

Action items I propose:
1) Kimberly to confirm invoicing cutover & AP contact details — will we need entity-level invoices or consolidated? (Kimberly: can you confirm the shortest onboarding timeline?)
2) Karthik to draft a short OF paragraph that encodes the phased min-commit (tranche dates and re-allocation rule) and the evidence flow for VAT withholding.
3) Ben will confirm pricing schedule mapping and whether any SKU-level remapping is required if we split invoices by entity.

If we can get these back by COB Monday (28 Jul) we should be able to hit Simon's 1 Aug sign date.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, simon.lawrence@cleartower.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleartower order form — invoice routing, phased minimum commit

Grace / Simon — quick operational note from Finance:

- Shortest onboarding to support entity-level invoices is ~10 business days from receipt of billing contacts, tax IDs, and PO references. Consolidated monthly invoice can be live immediately (same accounting entity) but may require Cleartower to self‑allocate in their ledger if they later request entity split.
- For withholding: Redwood's policy is to accept withholding but we need a tax certificate or official withholding slip from the paying entity within 45 days of payment; otherwise we cannot issue a credit. We can add the required language to the OF.
- Regarding re-allocation of unused commit: Finance is ok with an intra-year reallocation if the OF includes (a) maximum flexibility clause (reallocation allowed up to remaining commitment balance) and (b) a 30‑day notice for any material reallocation >25% of a tranche.

Attachment: Cleartower_Billing-entity-map.xlsx (sample mapping template).

Ben — on pricing mapping: if we route entity invoices we need the line items tagged to entity IDs. Can you confirm if Cleartower expects SKU changes?

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: simon.lawrence@cleartower.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleartower order form — invoice routing, phased minimum commit

Simon — thanks for the patience; quick commercial confirmation after syncing with pricing and legal ops.

- Pricing schedule: We will accept the phased commit you suggested and model it on the OF as three tranches with the following invoice cadence: invoice for Q1 tranche on contract start date, Q2 tranche invoiced at start of Q2, Q3 tranche invoiced at start of Q3. Each invoice will reference the purchase order shown in the OF.
- Re-allocation: We will include re-allocation language that allows Cleartower to reassign unused commit to other product SKUs within the Redwood catalog during the contract year, subject to a 30‑day notice for reallocations >25% of an upcoming tranche.
- Invoice routing & VAT: Redwood will support consolidated monthly invoice by default. If Cleartower requires entity-level invoices for VAT/residency reasons, we'll proceed but will need the entity mapping file (template attached by Kimberly) and a 10 business day lead time. If Cleartower withholds VAT, Redwood requires the official withholding slip/tax certificate within 45 days to grant tax credit.

Next steps:
1) Simon / Cleartower to confirm preferred invoice routing (consolidated vs. entity-level) and provide billing contacts, tax IDs, and PO numbers.
2) Karthik will push a short OF addendum (1 paragraph + schedule table) to reflect tranches and re-allocation rules; will share redline by EOD Wed.
3) Once we have routing choice + entity map (if needed), Redwood will prepare final OF for signature (DocuSign).

DocuSign link to follow once OF is final.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
